from pwn import *
from re import *

context.log_level = "debug"

# p = process("./prob")
p = remote('host3.dreamhack.games',개인PORT주소)

for x in range(1,11):
    p.recvuntil(b'[INFO] ')
    l = list(map(int, re.search(rb"HP:\s*(\d+), STR:\s*(\d+), AGI:\s*(\d+), VIT:\s*(\d+), INT:\s*(\d+), END:\s*(\d+), DEX:\s*(\d+)",p.recvline()).groups()))
    print(l)

    s=((p8(l[1])+p8(l[2])+p8(l[3])+p8(l[4])+p8(l[5])+p8(l[6])+p16(l[0])))
    print(s)
    
    s=int.from_bytes(s, "little")
    print(s)
    
    r=""
    while(s>1):
        if (s%2==0):
            r="B"+r
            s= s//2
        else:
            r="A"+r
            s-=1

    p.recvuntil(b'Cast your spell!: ')
    p.sendline(("A"+r).encode())
    if (b"defeated." in p.recvline()): print(f"{x} clear")
    
    
p.interactive()
